title: Prospective interpretation boundary for the matched-update half-label experiment
information_boundary: Written while all 32 continuation runs were still in progress. No convergence-extension loss, validation metric, or test result was inspected.
status: prospective amendment; the original numerical gates and analysis remain unchanged
takes_precedence_over: The phrase 'close as optimization-only' in preregistration.json.
Any branch in prospective_scientific_branch_map.json that treats failure of the half-label gate as proof that the same-budget pretraining gain is transient.

identification.what_the_running_experiment_identifies: The running pretrained-64 versus scratch-128 comparison identifies H_U at matched update counts and can decide whether pretraining replaces half of the target labels under the registered gate.
identification.what_it_does_not_identify: Because it has no matched-update scratch-64 arm, it does not identify D_U or G_U separately and therefore cannot decide whether a smaller same-budget pretraining gain persists after convergence.

allowed_conclusions.if_half_label_gate_passes: Persistent half-label saving is plausible and warrants the registered multi-seed, multi-checkpoint confirmation.
allowed_conclusions.if_half_label_gate_closes: Pretraining does not replace half of the target labels under this protocol. This alone does not show that pretraining is merely an optimization warm start or that its label-equivalent saving is zero.
allowed_conclusions.if_plateau_or_rate_gate_fails: No transfer interpretation is licensed until the same comparison is stabilized.

revised_next_question_if_half_label_gate: At the same final update budget, does pretrained-64 retain a material advantage over scratch-64, and what intermediate scratch sample count matches pretrained-64 error?
minimum_deciding_evidence: Add matched-update scratch-64 for the same target subsets, architectures, families, and validation protocol to estimate G_U.
If G_U persists, add the smallest set of intermediate target-only sample counts needed to bracket the label-equivalent saving.
Change the source distribution or architecture only after establishing whether a persistent gain exists and how large it is.
test_policy: All SHIFT-SUV test cases remain sealed.
